app.name: PumpkinOS
app.long_description:
PumpkinOS runs PalmOS applications: Memo Pad, Address Book, To Do List, Date Book, a web browser, a mail client, GNUBoy and more.
The GamePad touch screen is the pen. A is Enter, B is Escape, + goes back to the Launcher, - is Tab, the D-pad sends the arrow keys, L/R are Page Up/Down. The picture is shown on the TV and on the GamePad.
Options go in pumpkin.cfg next to pumpkinos.rpx or in sd:/wiiu/pumpkinos/ (see README.md).
